basic_profile.bio: I'm a 45-year-old mechanical engineer based in Birmingham, UK. I have a passion for cars, particularly Kia Souls, and enjoy tinkering with engines in my free time. Besides cars, I'm a big fan of historical dramas and sci-fi series, which I often watch with my dad on weekends. I work a 9-to-5 job at an automotive design firm and spend my evenings either in the garage or catching up on the latest TV series. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom to explore my hobbies. I'm typically online during evenings and weekends, looking for car repair tips or TV show recommendations.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Manchester, and I've spent over 20 years in the automotive industry. My expertise in car mechanics comes from both formal education and hands-on experience. I'm an active member of several car enthusiast communities, where I share tips and tricks related to car maintenance and repair.
